Stripe subscription + one-time checkout return live test session URLs; high-ticket products ($7K/$27K) are correctly rejected from /api/checkout/session and route through /apply application flow only. action_items: OPTIONAL: Add a /api/health alias returning {status:'ok'} or update internal documentation to point to /api/ (current healthcheck endpoint).
OPTIONAL: Update internal product/plan-key naming docs to match the actual codebase (cb_starter_monthly / cb_pro_monthly / accelerator_7k / mastery_27k) so future reviews use the correct keys.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~880 lines and starting to mix concerns (catalog, payments, applications, picker analytics, TTS, LLM). Consider splitting into routers (payments_router, applications_router, admin_router, llm_router) before adding more features.

Subscription checkout (line 610-674) currently uses one-time CheckoutSessionRequest with a comment acknowledging this — buyer will be charged once, not recurring, until native Stripe subscription mode is wired. This is a known limitation but MUST be flipped to mode='subscription' before turning live keys on, otherwise $49/mo and $149/mo will only charge a single time.
/api/portal/login returns the portal_token round-trip success but no rate-limiting; consider adding basic throttling before going live to avoid token enumeration.

ADMIN_TOKENS is an in-memory dict — fine for single-instance preview, but tokens will be lost on restart and won't work across replicas in production. Move to DB-backed tokens or short-lived JWT before scaling.
Webhook signature verification depends on Emergent integrations wrapper; verify STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set when switching to live keys, otherwise handle_webhook will silently skip verification.
